summary: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to expand the definition of a historically Black college or university (HBCU) by changing the establishment date criterion from 1964 to November 8, 1965.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Higher Education Act of 1965 to expand the definition of a Historically Black College or University (HBCU) by changing a date. This change could potentially make more institutions eligible for federal funding and programs designated for HBCUs, thus increasing spending on these specific public (and private) educational institutions. The bill is entirely focused on this definitional change within higher education.
